name: Taqueria La Abundancia
tagline: Authentic Mexican food from a Brenham food truck.
about: Taqueria La Abundancia is a Brenham food truck serving a wide variety of authentic Mexican food.
The menu covers breakfast tacos, burritos, street tacos, quesadillas, gorditas and aguas frescas, and the truck also caters.
conflicts: No phone number or hours were found. As a food truck, its location may change; the address is the one MapQuest lists.
